Answer: {{answer}}" :question/worked-solution "First, we just take the constant out of the derivative and use the result for the derivative of $\operatorname{cot}x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{'}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-18\operatorname{cot}x) \\  & =-18(-\csc^{2}x) \\  & =18\csc^{2}x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $x=\frac{\pi }{6}$ in the derivative and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{'}(\frac{\pi }{6}) & =18\csc^{2}(\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =18{(2)}^{2} \\  & =72.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["2e06b933-b611-5729-8f6a-7ac93664106e"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "a288e9a3-a0a4-5506-a535-342896e55335" :answer/id #uuid "a288e9a3-a0a4-5506-a535-342896e55335" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "20" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "df78fbb8-649e-5da6-b3de-db8383faee78" :answer-field/id #uuid "df78fbb8-649e-5da6-b3de-db8383faee78" :answer-field/key "answer" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank :answer-field/choices ["a288e9a3-a0a4-5506-a535-342896e55335"] :answer-field/correct "a288e9a3-a0a4-5506-a535-342896e55335" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "f063162f-159a-5fb0-8426-190c82972357" :question/id #uuid "f063162f-159a-5fb0-8426-190c82972357" :question/problem "Find ${f}^{'}(\frac{\pi }{6})$ if $f(x)=-5\operatorname{cot}x.$
